title: Mercenary Badge Insert
prompt:
Jeralt's gloved hand places the old mercenary badge on the wooden desk. The metal settles with weight near candlelight, maps, and closed books. The insert should feel personal and ominous, connecting Byleth's past to the monastery.

Camera: close insert, tiny push toward the badge.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: readable writing, magical glow, modern props. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
